history.sg_progress: The Administration wishes to reiterate that all recruitment is conducted in Inspira through job openings. The evaluation of candidates, including a comparative analysis of candidates and recommendations, is captured and stored in the Inspira platform. As part of the existing standard operating procedures, hiring managers are required to comply with the policy framework for the administration of temporary appointments, including with regard to the availability of funding and the provision of proper justification before extending such appointments. The Administration is developing operational guidance on temporary appointments and temporary assignments that highlights the need to include appropriate justification and data.
